name: starglass_impact
notes: The shard shatters: a hard 8-ray star flash, a ring of glints thrown out, glass slivers and chips tumbling (any-angle spin), bouncing and settling on the floor 54 px (1.4 m) below the anchor, a few glints on the settled glass. Anchor = hit point in the air at ~1.4 m (the shot's flight height); if the shot hits at another height the debris floor is off by the difference.
